contenido: Treat all players with respect. Insults, discrimination, harassment and spam in public chat are not allowed. Personal disputes must be resolved in private or with a GM.
Any use of external programs that alter the game (bots, speedhacks, flyhacks, etc.) will result in a permanent account ban without prior notice.
If you find a bug, report it to the staff. Exploiting a bug for advantage (items, gold, experience, etc.) is forbidden and may result in removal of what was obtained and a sanction.
Selling, buying or trading accounts, characters, items or gold for real money is not allowed. This infraction results in a permanent ban.
Respect the rules of your group or raid. Ninja looting (keeping items that are not yours) or deliberately leaving an ongoing raid without a justified reason is not allowed.
Character and guild names must be appropriate. Offensive, racist, sexual or impersonating staff or player names are forbidden.
Each player is responsible for their account. Sharing your password with another person is at your own risk. The staff is not responsible for account theft for this reason.
GM decisions are final. If you disagree with a sanction, you can open a ticket or contact an administrator, but never argue publicly in chat or be disrespectful.
